attributes.during: After adding villains and henchmen, shuffle 1 henchman Stolen Larvae into each location deck.When you discard cards as damage, first choose Stolen Larvae if you have any. When you would banish Stolen Larvae or put it into a deck or pile, shuffle it into a random open location deck instead.You win the scenario when all of the Stolen Larvae are in characters' hands. (You do not have to defeat and corner the villain.)
